unit.why: An anecdote told by R. B. in the name of his master R. Shlomo: after his marriage R. Shlomo secretly began learning goldsmithing to earn a living, and his wife stopped it so he would study Torah.
unit.boundary_note: story continues into next division (the wife sends him to Nikolsburg to study with R. Shmelke)

stories.start_quote: עוד סיפר הה״ק ר״ב מה ששמע
stories.summary_en: After his support years were running out, the young R. Shlomo secretly arranged to learn goldsmithing so he would not have to take a rabbinic post, but his wife, trusting that God would provide, went to the goldsmith and threatened to curse him until he stopped teaching her husband.
